verses.text: This is the vision Isaiah son of Amoz saw about Judah and Jerusalem while Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah.
Heavens, hear! Earth, listen! The LORD has spoken. “I raised children and cared for them, and they rebelled against me.
An ox knows its owner, and a donkey knows its master's feeding trough. But Israel doesn't know me. My people don't stop to think.”

What a sinful nation, weighed down with wrongdoing! You're the offspring of evildoers, children who act corruptly. They've abandoned the LORD, despised the Holy One of Israel, and turned away from him.
Why take another beating and go right on rebelling? Your whole head is sick, and your whole heart is weak.
From the soles of your feet to the top of your head, nothing is healthy. There are wounds, welts, and open sores, with no one to close them, bandage them, or soothe them with oil.
Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned. Strangers devour your land right in front of you, leaving it desolate as if foreigners had overthrown it.
Daughter Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, a hut in a melon field, a city under siege.
If the LORD of Armies hadn't left us a tiny remnant, we'd have ended up like Sodom. We'd have been like Gomorrah.
Hear the LORD's word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to our God's instruction, you people of Gomorrah!
“What do I want with all your sacrifices?” says the LORD. “I've had enough of burnt rams and the fat of well-fed animals. I take no pleasure in the blood of bulls, lambs, or male goats.
When you come to stand before me, who asked you to trample through my courts?
Stop bringing empty offerings. Your incense is detestable to me. New Moons, Sabbaths, assemblies. I can't stand gatherings full of evil.
I hate your New Moons and appointed feasts with all my soul. They've become a burden, and I'm tired of carrying them.
When you spread out your hands, I'll turn my eyes away. No matter how many prayers you say, I won't listen. Your hands are full of blood.
Wash yourselves and get clean. Get your evil deeds out of my sight. Stop doing wrong.
Learn to do good. Seek justice. Help those who are oppressed. Defend children without fathers. Plead the widow's case.”
“Come, let's reason together,” says the LORD. “Even if your sins are scarlet, they'll be white as snow. Even if they're red like crimson, they'll be like wool.
If you're willing and obey, you'll eat the good things the land produces.
But if you refuse and rebel, the sword will devour you. The LORD himself has spoken.”
How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice. Righteousness lived there, and now murderers do.
Your silver has turned to slag, and your wine has been watered down.
Your rulers are rebels and friends of thieves. All of them love bribes and chase payouts. They don't defend children without fathers, and they won't hear a widow's case.
So the Lord, the GOD of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says, “Ah, I'll free myself from those who oppose me and take vengeance on my enemies.
I'll turn my hand against you. I'll thoroughly burn away your slag and remove all your tin.
I'll restore your judges and advisers, just as you had them at the beginning. After that you'll be called ‘The City of Righteousness, the Faithful City.’
Zion will be redeemed through justice, and those who turn back through righteousness.
But rebels and sinners will be broken together, and those who abandon the LORD will be consumed.
They'll be ashamed of the oaks you wanted, and you'll be humiliated by the gardens you chose.
You'll be like an oak with fading leaves, like a garden with no water.
The strong will be like tinder and their work like a spark. Both will burn together, and nobody will put out the fire.”
